patterns.note: Asymmetrical split-screen hero on the homepage, dedicating significant space to a prominent signup form on the right, balanced by an active lifestyle image on the left.

High-contrast color scheme utilizing a vibrant orange as the primary accent, effectively highlighting calls-to-action and key information against both dark (black/charcoal) and light (white/off-white) backgrounds.
Large, bold, sans-serif headings are used to introduce sections, often in title case, creating a strong visual hierarchy that guides the user through content.
No scroll-triggered motion or animations are observed on the initial homepage; content is presented statically without reveals, fades, or parallax effects.
Alternating background colors (light grey, white, dark charcoal) are used to clearly delineate distinct content sections, enhancing readability and visual separation.

technique_notes: The site employs a responsive grid system to create distinct content sections, frequently using a two-column layout where one column features an image or graphic and the other contains descriptive text and calls to action.
Primary calls-to-action are visually emphasized with a solid, vibrant orange background and contrasting white text, ensuring they stand out prominently across all page sections.

Visual hierarchy is established through a combination of large, bold sans-serif headings for section titles and smaller, lighter-weight text for descriptions, maintaining readability across varied background colors.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold headings (~3-4x body) with a clear hierarchy, supported by smaller, legible body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (e.g., 4-8px) on buttons, input fields, and card elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between sections and within content blocks, creating a clean and uncluttered feel.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a high-energy, vibrant orange as a primary accent color, paired with dynamic photography of athletes, creates an immediate sense of motivation and activity. This strong brand color is consistently applied to key calls-to-action, making them pop against both light and dark backgrounds.
